intro.text: A lean, six-limbed grazing animal of Roshar with very little carapace, found in northern Tashikk and Alethkar.

description.text: To move fast, an axehind leaps on four legs with its two clawed forelegs tucked in close. It shares some features with axehounds.
Axehinds graze in the open. Being prey, they startle easily and are quick to flee from danger.
